title: Chang'e Moon Ledger: Nightfall Survey
subtitle: A fictional field atlas of imagined lunar light and shadow.

sections.mission: This fictional project explores imagined lunar light and shadow. All settings and observations are invented. It links each illustration to field notes so readers can compare the evidence and follow the sequence.
sections.challenge: How can repeated moonlit sketches reveal a pattern across an invented night? A single illustration cannot explain the order of observations or why one interpretation was chosen. Each entry therefore records its place in the sequence, describes what changed, and keeps gaps in the imagined evidence visible.
approach: Compare painted sky panels and annotate each change in the same order.
impact: Show how an orderly sequence turns separate sketches into a readable night survey.

research.focus: Exploring the imagined themes of Chang'e Moon Ledger: Nightfall Survey in a fictional research record. Locations and measurements remain imaginary.
